channel.title: Neuron Flame
channel.description: Voice-to-text at the speed of thought. Free, on-device dictation for macOS.

item.description:
v1.85 — Cleaner notch, no border, sits flush with the menu bar

  • Flush silhouette. The recorder pill is now exactly menu-bar-height (was overshooting by ~8pt). Reads as part of the notch hardware instead of a floating widget that hangs below it.
  • No border. Removed the rim stroke entirely. The brand-tinted breathing halo behind the pill now appears to emit from the silhouette directly — softer, more alive.
  • Halo unchanged. The gentle pulsing glow while recording is still there, just borderless.

Bonus: the website hero logo now sits on a clean white card against the dark page theme — pops the brand colours instead of fighting them.
